title: A two-attempt private escalation (a routine private sell; by the same code, a deliberate buy's private leg) that ends because its attempt budget ran out inside the swap's 60 s deadline is logged as mev.escalation.ceiling-hit and reported as "priority-fee ceiling reached", although its fees (1 and 2 gwei) never got near the 25 gwei ceiling, so the operator is told to raise a ceiling that did not bind

evidence.note: one branch for two causes: if (ceilingHit || attempt >= cfg.maxRetries) logs op mev.escalation.ceiling-hit and throws "MEV bundle not included after N attempt(s); priority-fee ceiling (<ceiling> wei) reached. Increase MEV_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI ..." whichever cause ended the loop
ceilingHit is computed (the clamped fee at the ceiling or the affordability bound) but the message does not use it

escalated fee = step x (attempt + 1); with the defaults (priorityFeeStepGwei 1 at :77, buyMaxPriorityFeeGwei 25 at :69) a two-attempt leg bids 1 and 2 gwei, so its attempt budget ends a calm-gas escalation long before the ceiling; a snipe's budget of four (1 to 4 gwei) is not reached at default settings on a realistic relay, because its swap deadline ends the escalation first

emitSnipeFailClean puts the thrown text in the buy.snipe.fail-clean reason, next to a remediation that says to raise MEV_BUY_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI; called from both snipe handlers (:1188 V2, :1513 V3)

real ETH V2 snipe, no bundle ever included: four attempts at one nonce with maxPriorityFeePerGas 1, 2, 3 and 4 gwei (decoded with real ethers); the bot logs mev.escalation.ceiling-hit at attempt 3 with ceilingWei 25000000000 and buy.snipe.fail-clean reason "MEV bundle not included after 4 attempt(s); priority-fee ceiling (25000000000 wei) reached. ..." (claim attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit). A separate message for the attempt-budget case reads looks fixed (scratch src mutation, restored identical). First seen in the warn/error lines of AUD-TX-003's run. Superseded 2026-11-12: this run used a simulated relay that answered success for a simulation of an expired swap; with realistic reverts (780d67d) the snipe's second or third attempt is refused as UniswapV2Router: EXPIRED, so claim attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit was retired (operator ruling, PN-002)

evidence.ref: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project realpath test/realpath/triage/AUD-TX-029.test.ts (Node 22.16.0, 2026-11-12; realistic reverts by default since 780d67d; test re-triaged in eb34470)
evidence.note: a real ETH V2 stop-loss private sell, MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS default 2, a router sell read that enforces the swap deadline, each target block 2 s after its bundle: first sell sent at t0 with decoded deadline t0 + 59.53 s; attempt 0 not-landed at t0 + 52.27 s; attempt 1 sent at t0 + 52.29 s, inside the deadline, and missed; mev.escalation.ceiling-hit attempt 1 at t0 + 104.56 s ('MEV bundle not included after 2 attempt(s); priority-fee ceiling (25000000000 wei) reached. Increase MEV_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI ...') with fees 1 and 2 gwei decoded from the signed bundle transactions (claim sell-attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit); the exit then completes on the public fallback. In-memory mutants: a separate attempt-budget message reads looks fixed; the same message only for a snipe-sized budget (attempt >= 3) does not

evidence.ref: Phase 23 code-review fixer A measurement (worktree fix23-A, Node 22.16.0, 2026-11-12; a temporary probe, removed before commit): the 2026-11-11 snipe flow with realistic reverts, bundles never included, each target block 12 s after its bundle
evidence.note: the snipe sent 1 bundle (1 gwei); attempt 0 not-landed at 64 520 fake ms; attempt 1's eth_callBundle at 64 540 ms was past the swap deadline (launch + about 60 s) and refused (UniswapV2Router: EXPIRED, flashbots.simulate.revert attempt 1); buy.snipe.fail-clean at 64 540 ms with reason 'Flashbots simulate: tx would revert (execution reverted)'; 0 mev.escalation.ceiling-hit lines. The unchanged 2026-11-11 test read 'AUD-TX-029 now behaves correctly' on that chain. Same branch with a target block 12 s after each bundle on the V2 stop-loss sell: attempt 0 ends at about 64 s, attempt 1's simulation is refused as expired, no ceiling-hit

sibling_sites_checked: Every throw of the escalation loop in reconciliation.ts at 23a6461 (unaffordable :529-542, mined-but-reverted :593-596 and landed-not-ours :599-602, the ceiling-or-budget branch :606-614, the defensive loop-exhausted throw :624-628): only :606-614 merges two causes into one ceiling text. The defensive throw after the loop, normally unreachable because :606 throws first on the last attempt, has a correct text but is also logged under op mev.escalation.ceiling-hit. Its callers: the three strategies' submitWithReconciliation (flashbots, bloxroute, passthrough), so the deliberate private leg (bot.ts escalatePrivateBuy, DELIBERATE_BUY_PRIVATE_ATTEMPTS default 2) and the private sells (escalatePrivateSell, MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS default 2) get the same text when their budgets run out. The wrong knob name in the same text is AUD-TX-010; that the helper's own alert never reaches Telegram is AUD-TX-017. Re-checked 2026-11-12 on the realistic chain: the snipe and the partial sells (src/exitEngine.ts:1531) both run sendTxWithRetry's default budget of 4, which cannot be reached inside a 60 s swap deadline at default settings, so they end on the expired simulation, not on this branch (the snipe measured, the partial sell a code read). The two-attempt legs reach it when their first attempt ends inside the deadline: the routine private sell (measured) and the deliberate buy's private leg (bot.ts:544 privDeadline now + 60 s, DELIBERATE_BUY_PRIVATE_ATTEMPTS default 2 at :557; a code read, not measured). The anti-rug sell makes one private attempt (privateAttemptBudget, exitEngine.ts:453-456), so a miss ends it on the same branch after one attempt at 1 gwei (a code read).
severity_rationale: S3, capital none, graded by the 23-09 executor under the operator's standing instruction of 2026-11-11 ("All the bugs are going to get fixed. The S1, 2 or whatever doesn't matter. Don't interrupt sessions to ask me about upgrading or downgrading"), without a stop; narrowed 2026-11-12 by operator ruling (process note PN-002), severity unchanged. The bot's behavior is correct (the sell completes on the public fallback, nothing is overspent); what is wrong is the diagnosis it gives. Measured on the real path with a simulated relay that refuses an expired swap (Phase 23 code-review fix run, WR-01): a stop-loss private sell (MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS default 2) whose first attempt ends inside the sell's 60 s deadline sends its second attempt at 2 gwei, misses, and the bot logs mev.escalation.ceiling-hit and says the 25 gwei ceiling was reached and should be raised. That needs the first attempt's target block early in its slot (2 s after the bundle in the test); with the block 12 s after the bundle the first attempt ends at about 64 s, the second attempt's simulation is refused as expired, and no ceiling-hit is logged. The snipe case first registered (four attempts all missing) does not happen at default settings on a realistic relay, because the snipe's own swap deadline ends its escalation after 1 or 2 bundles. No capital effect and no safety bypass, so S3.
recommendation: Give the two causes their own outcome: when ceilingHit is false and the budget ran out, log and throw an attempt-budget message (attempts used, highest fee bid, the ceiling) under its own op, and point the remediation at MEV_PRIORITY_FEE_STEP_GWEI / the attempt budget and builder coverage; keep the ceiling text for a real ceiling or affordability hit. Fix the knob name with AUD-TX-010 (Phase 29 card TX-03 area). test/realpath/triage/AUD-TX-029.test.ts (the two-attempt sell leg) reads looks fixed for a separate attempt-budget message; the same message given only for a snipe-sized budget does not. Nothing is fixed in Phase 23.

triage.note: Re-triaged on the realistic chain (Phase 23 code-review fix run, WR-01; narrowed by operator ruling 2026-11-12, PN-002): a real ETH V2 position bought and armed falls 41 percent when another trader dumps, and the real stop-loss escalates privately with MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS at its default of 2; the router's sell read enforces the swap deadline and each target block arrives 2 s after its bundle; both attempts (1 and 2 gwei at one nonce, decoded with real ethers) are sent inside the sell's 60 s deadline and miss, yet the bot logs mev.escalation.ceiling-hit and reports the 25 gwei priority-fee ceiling as reached (claim sell-attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit); the exit then completes on the public fallback. A separate attempt-budget message reads looks fixed; the same message given only for a snipe-sized budget (attempt >= 3) does not. The first claim, attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit (a snipe whose four attempts all miss), is retired: on a realistic relay the snipe's own swap deadline ends its escalation after 1 or 2 bundles and no ceiling-hit is logged. Not in the frozen population; recorded so check.ts can locate its claim.
